name: nlm-expert-research-mcp-frontier
description: Source-locked, evidence-first NotebookLM research with persistent authentication and structured citations.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Research one NotebookLM corpus and return a source-locked evidence capsule.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.description: List live NotebookLM expert notebooks with explicit stale-catalog signaling.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List authoritative RPC source IDs and titles for one notebook.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Frontier, authentication, and upstream transport readiness.

tools.name: notebook_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a live notebook by title, alias, ID, or URL.

tools.name: notebook_refresh
tools.description: Refresh notebooks and optionally a notebook's sources.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve evidence from a prior research capsule.

tools.name: compare_notebooks
tools.description: Compare two notebooks while preserving provenance.

tools.name: setup_auth
tools.description: Open Chrome for secure Google authentication or forced reauthentication.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Inspect runtime, transport, registry, and security state.
